content_html: I would very much like the opportunity to talk to you about the technology that we offer and how it might benefit your company. I am a rep at Logix Communications. We provide T1 (and bonded T1’s) and PRI service. We provide a very high level of customer service and have been serving Texas for almost thirty years. I would like the opportunity to talk with you with the hope of working together in the future. Would you have time next Tuesday at 10:00 or Thursday at 2:00?
